name: speckit-specify

# speckit-specify

Use for non-trivial new work that needs a spec.

## Instructions

1. Read `.specify/templates/commands/specify.md`, the constitution, and the spec template.
2. Create the next `.specify/specs/NNN-feature-name/spec.md`.
3. Capture what and why, not implementation.
4. Include prioritized user stories, requirements, non-goals, and at most 3 clarification markers.
